title: Living with 30 People in a Smoky Longhouse
hook: In the dead of winter, an entire Norse clan slept around a trench fire with no chimney.

scenes.text: When sub-zero blizzards hit Scandinavia, survival meant crowding an entire extended family into a single turf-insulated longhouse.

scenes.voicedText: When sub-zero blizzards hit Scandinavia, survival meant crowding an entire extended family into a single turf-insulated longhouse.

scenes.text: Down the center ran a long open hearth trench burning peat, birch logs, and seal blubber. But there was no chimney.
scenes.imagePrompt: Long stone-lined open hearth pit burning glowing peat and logs in the center of an earthen longhouse floor. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Down the center ran a long open hearth trench burning peat, birch logs, and seal blubber. But there was no chimney.

scenes.text: Smoke escaped only through small ceiling slits, leaving a thick haze hanging over everyone's heads and blackening the rafters with soot.

scenes.voicedText: Smoke escaped only through small ceiling slits, leaving a thick haze hanging over everyone's heads and blackening the rafters with soot.

scenes.text: To preserve body heat, livestock including dairy cows, sheep, and pigs were housed at the far end of the same building behind wattle hurdles.

scenes.text: Up to thirty people slept on raised wooden benches lined with heather and sheepskins, listening to skaldic poets recite epic sagas in the gloom.
